plugin.name: RankTracker
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Finds you (or anyone) in the yearly/monthly/weekly/daily top 100 rankings

muclient.script:
local PERIODS = { yrank = { cmd = "yrank", label = "Yearly" }, mrank = { cmd = "mrank", label = "Monthly" }, drank = { cmd = "drank", label = "Daily" }, wrank = { cmd = "wrank", label = "Weekly" }, }
-- short "rt" aliases -> the matching rank command local RT = { yrt = "yrank", mrt = "mrank", drt = "drank", wrt = "wrank" }
-- friendly per-stat commands ("pupreport" etc.) -- num = the game's ranking category number -- keys = words expected in the game's category title; if none match, the -- report warns that the number is probably wrong -- 16 (powerups) and 2 (quest points) are confirmed by the user. The others -- follow the table's column order (Level, Total Qp, Mob Kills, Deaths, Gquests, -- Quests) plus 18 = Campaigns; GQChecker's "myrank 5" agrees with 5 = gquests. local STATS = { pup = { num = 16, label = "Powerups", short = "Pups", keys = { "powerup" } }, qp = { num = 2, label = "Quest Points", short = "QP", keys = { "qp", "point" } }, cp = { num = 18, label = "Campaigns", short = "CPs", keys = { "campaign" } }, gq = { num = 5, label = "Gquests", short = "GQs", keys = { "gquest", "global" } }, quest = { num = 6, label = "Quests", short = "Quests", keys = { "quest" } }, kill = { num = 3, label = "Mob Kills", short = "Kills", keys = { "kill" } }, death = { num = 4, label = "Deaths", short = "Deaths", keys = { "death" } }, level = { num = 1, label = "Levels", short = "Levels", keys = { "level" } }, }
-- metarank: the order the stats are asked for and shown in local META_ORDER = { "level", "qp", "cp", "gq", "quest", "kill", "death", "pup" } -- order to match a metarank title against the stats: the specific words -- first, because "Quest Points Earned" and "Gquests" both contain "quest" local META_MATCH = { "pup", "cp", "gq", "qp", "kill", "death", "level", "quest" } local META_QUIET = 2.0 -- metarank replies are 500 lines each; allow a longer gap -- meta / metarank = best day, metayear = best year (-y), metaweek = best week (-w) local META_KINDS = { day = { key = "day", flag = "", word = "daily", label = "Daily" }, year = { key = "year", flag = " -y", word = "yearly", label = "Yearly" }, week = { key = "week", flag = " -w", word = "weekly", label = "Weekly" }, } -- "" / "rank" / "day" -> day, "year" / "y" -> year, "week" / "w" -> week local function meta_kind(word) local w = (word or ""):lower() if w == "year" or w == "y" or w == "yearly" then return "year" end if w == "week" or w == "w" or w == "weekly" then return "week" end return "day" end
-- period words accepted by the stat commands -> the rt key local PERIOD_WORDS = { d = "drt", day = "drt", daily = "drt", w = "wrt", week = "wrt", weekly = "wrt", m = "mrt", month = "mrt", monthly = "mrt", y = "yrt", year = "yrt", yearly = "yrt", }
-- order the all-periods report is shown in local PORDER = { { key = "daily", cmd = "drank", label = "Daily" }, { key = "weekly", cmd = "wrank", label = "Weekly" }, { key = "monthly", cmd = "mrank", label = "Monthly" }, { key = "yearly", cmd = "yrank", label = "Yearly" }, }
local VERSION = "2.4" -- keep in step with version= in the plugin tag above local TOP_N = 100 local CATS = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 16, 18 } -- categories to scan local QUIET = 1.0 -- seconds of silence = scan finished
-- known stat columns, in the order they might appear in the table header local COLNAMES = { "Level", "Total Qp", "Mob Kills", "Deaths", "Gquests", "Quests", "Campaigns" }
local scan = nil -- active scan state, nil when idle local gState = nil -- GMCP char.status state (3 active, 4 AFK, 8 combat ...), nil until seen local gPK = false -- GMCP room.info details has a "pk" flag local lastscan = nil -- finished scan, for rankdebug
-- colours: @x099 yellow, @x045 cyan, @W white, @x048 green -- (also the standard Aardwolf letter codes, needed for the clan tags) local ANSI = { r = "31", g = "32", y = "33", b = "34", m = "35", c = "36", w = "37", D = "1;30", R = "1;31", G = "1;32", Y = "1;33", B = "1;34", M = "1;35", C = "1;36", W = "1;37" }
local function cnote(s) s = s:gsub("@@", "\1") s = s:gsub("@x(%d%d%d)", function(n) return "\27[0;38;5;" .. tonumber(n) .. "m" end) s = s:gsub("@([rgybmcwDRGYBMCW])", function(c) return "\27[0;" .. ANSI[c] .. "m" end) s = s:gsub("\1", "@") AnsiNote(s .. "\27[0m") end
-- shortened clan tags (Aardwolf colour codes; all are 3 visible characters wide) local CLANTAGS = { crimson = "@Y|@RC@Y|", bard = "@W~@RB@W~", druid = "@W/@gD@W\\", gaardian = "@M<@WG@M>", retribution = "@r>@x252R@r>", touchstone = "@G>@WT@G<", loqui = "@w:@rL@w:", xunti = "@r^@bX@r^", amazon = "@m]@GA@m[", twinlobe = "@G!@CT@G!", imperium = "@R>@WI@R>", boot = "@x226|@x048B@x226|", perdition = "@R+@WP@R+", rhabdo = "@W^@WR@W^", light = "@x032)@WL@x032(", hook = "@C}@YH@C{", pyre = "@C/@cP@C\\", masaki = "@W=@RM@W=", watchmen = "@Y|@x238W@Y|", crusader = "@M=@WC@M=", seekers = "@M(@YS@M)", emerald = "@C[@GE@C]", wolf = "@R:@WW@R:", baal = "@r[@RB@r]", tao = "@g/@wT@g/", }
-- tag for a clan name; no clan -> `blank` (spaces to keep columns aligned, or "" for channels) local function clan_tag(clan, blank) blank = blank or "" if not clan or clan == "" then return blank end local k = clan:lower() if k == "none" then return blank end return CLANTAGS[k] or ("@w" .. clan) -- clan without a listed tag: show its plain name end
-- default name: manual override (rankname) > logged-in character (GMCP) > world name local function myname() local n = GetVariable("charname") if n == nil or n == "" then n = GetVariable("selfname") end if n == nil or n == "" then n = WorldName() end return n end
local function shorten(cat) cat = cat:gsub("%s*Completed$", "") return cat end
-- which table column holds this category's total? local function pick_col(cat, cols) local c = cat:lower() local want if c:find("campaign") then want = "Campaigns" elseif c:find("gquest") or c:find("global") then want = "Gquests" elseif c:find("death") then want = "Deaths" elseif c:find("kill") then want = "Mob Kills" elseif c:find("point") or c:find("qp") then want = "Total Qp" elseif c:find("quest") then want = "Quests" elseif c:find("level") then want = "Level" end if want then for i, name in ipairs(cols) do if name == want then return i end end return nil -- known stat but its column isn't in this table: show "?" rather than a wrong number end -- unfamiliar category (e.g. "Powerups (Total)"): match a column named in the title local flat = c:gsub("%W", "") for i, name in ipairs(cols) do local cn = (name:lower():gsub("%s", "")) if flat:find(cn, 1, true) then return i end end -- otherwise assume the ranked value is the last column of the table if #cols > 0 then return #cols end return nil end
--------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GMCP: learn who is logged in ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation(msg_type, data) if msg_type ~= 201 or not data then return end if data:sub(1, 9) == "char.base" then local n = data:match('"name"%s*:%s*"([^"]+)"') if n and n ~= "" then SetVariable("selfname", n) end elseif data:sub(1, 11) == "char.status" then local st = data:match('"state"%s*:%s*"?(%d+)') if st then gState = tonumber(st) end elseif data:sub(1, 9) == "room.info" then local d = data:match('"details"%s*:%s*"([^"]*)"') or "" gPK = false for flag in d:gmatch("[^,]+") do if flag:gsub("%s", ""):lower():sub(1, 2) == "pk" then gPK = true end end end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------- -- scan engine ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local finish
local function arm(delay, fn) DoAfterSpecial(delay, fn .. "(" .. scan.gen .. ")", 12) end
local function touch() scan.gen = scan.gen + 1 arm(scan.quiet or QUIET, "OnRankQuiet") end
local function close_cur() if scan.cur then table.insert(scan.done, scan.cur) scan.cur = nil end end
function OnRankQuiet(g) if scan and g == scan.gen then finish() end end
function OnRankStart(g) -- nothing came back at all if scan and g == scan.gen and #scan.done == 0 and not scan.cur then finish() end end
function on_header(name, line, w) if not scan then return end close_cur() scan.cur = { period = (w[1] or ""):lower(), cat = w[2], cols = {}, rows = {}, rank = nil, nums = nil } touch() end
function on_colhdr(name, line, w) if not (scan and scan.cur) then return end local found = {} local hdr = w[1] or "" local covered = {} for _, cn in ipairs(COLNAMES) do local pos = hdr:find(cn, 1, true) if pos then found[#found + 1] = { pos = pos, name = cn } for k = pos, pos + #cn - 1 do covered[k] = true end end end -- any other word in the header is treated as an extra (unknown) column for pos, tok in hdr:gmatch("()(%S+)") do if not covered[pos] then found[#found + 1] = { pos = pos, name = tok } end end table.sort(found, function(a, b) return a.pos < b.pos end) for _, f in ipairs(found) do scan.cur.cols[#scan.cur.cols + 1] = f.name end scan.cur.colidx = pick_col(scan.cur.cat, scan.cur.cols) touch() end
function on_row(name, line, w) if not (scan and scan.cur) then return end local cur = scan.cur local rank, who, clan = string.match(line, "^%s*(%d+)%)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)") -- a name with a space in it (e.g. "MEGAN 2.01") pushes a number into the clan slot: ignore it if clan and clan:match("^[%d%.]+$") then clan = nil end if rank and who then rank = tonumber(rank) local isme = (who:lower() == scan.target:lower()) if scan.rt or scan.top then -- single-category mode: keep every row so the neighbours / top 10 can be shown local nums = {} for n in line:gmatch("%d+") do nums[#nums + 1] = n end cur.rows[rank] = { who = who, clan = clan, nums = nums } if isme and not cur.rank then cur.rank = rank; cur.who = who end elseif not cur.rank and rank <= TOP_N and isme then local nums = {} for n in line:gmatch("%d+") do nums[#nums + 1] = n end local ncols = #cur.cols if ncols == 0 then ncols = 1 end -- stat columns are the LAST ncols numbers on the row (names may contain digits) cur.rank = rank cur.who = who if cur.colidx then cur.total = nums[#nums - ncols + cur.colidx] end cur.nums = nums end end touch() end
--------------------------------------------------------------------- -- metarank: the game's all-time top 500 daily results per category ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- does the game's category title look like the stat we asked for? local function stat_ok(st, cat) local c = (cat or ""):lower() for _, k in ipairs(st.keys) do if c:find(k, 1, true) then return true end end return false end
-- which stat a metarank title belongs to; falls back to the send order local function meta_stat(title, idx) local t = (title or ""):lower() for _, k in ipairs(META_MATCH) do for _, word in ipairs(STATS[k].keys) do if t:find(word, 1, true) then return k end end end return META_ORDER[idx] end
function on_meta_header(name, line, w) if not (scan and scan.meta) then return end close_cur() scan.cur = { cat = w[3], limit = tonumber(w[1]), key = meta_stat(w[3], #scan.done + 1) } touch() end
function on_meta_touch(name, line, w) if scan and scan.meta then touch() end end
function on_meta_row(name, line, w) if not (scan and scan.meta) then return end local cur = scan.cur if cur then -- every row is kept for the saved lists (v2.4); the list is sorted best first, -- so the player's first row is their best day local row = { place = tonumber(w[1]), who = w[2], value = w[4], date = (w[5]:gsub("%s+", " ")) } cur.rows = cur.rows or {} cur.rows[#cur.rows + 1] = row if not cur.best and scan.target and w[2]:lower() == scan.target:lower() then cur.best = row end end touch() end
-- 1 -> "1st", 3 -> "3rd", 12 -> "12th", 22 -> "22nd" local function ordinal(n) local suf = "th" local t = n % 100 if t < 11 or t > 13 then suf = ({ [1] = "st", [2] = "nd", [3] = "rd" })[n % 10] or "th" end return n .. suf end
--------------------------------------------------------------------- -- saved metarank lists (v2.4): read on a schedule, looked up instantly ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local mcache = {} -- day / week / year -> { stamp, at, lists = { [statkey] = {cat, limit, rows} } } local KIND_ORDER = { "day", "week", "year" } local REFRESH_RETRY = 600 -- a refresh that got nothing at all is tried again 10 minutes later local gRefreshTry = {} -- kind -> os.time() of the last refresh attempt
-- the latest 12:01am slot for a kind, as a stamp: day = its date, week = that -- Sunday's date, year = the year. A saved set with a different stamp is due. local function meta_due(kind, t) local b = (t or os.time()) - 60 -- the switch is at 12:01am: step back a minute, then read the date if kind == "year" then return os.date("%Y", b) end if kind == "week" then local d = os.date("*t", b) -- wday 1 = Sunday return os.date("%Y-%m-%d", os.time({ year = d.year, month = d.month, day = d.day - (d.wday - 1), hour = 12 })) end return os.date("%Y-%m-%d", b) end
local function meta_file() -- GetPluginInfo 6 is the plugin's .xml FILE; keep the folder only local f = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 6) or "" return (f:match("^(.*[\\/])") or "") .. "RankTracker_meta.txt" end
local function tabfree(x) return (tostring(x or ""):gsub("[\t\r\n]", " ")) end
local function meta_save() local out = { "# RankTracker saved metarank lists - rebuilt by the plugin, safe to delete" } for _, kind in ipairs(KIND_ORDER) do local e = mcache[kind] if e then out[#out + 1] = table.concat({ "K", kind, e.stamp or "", tostring(e.at or 0) }, "\t") for _, key in ipairs(META_ORDER) do local l = e.lists[key] if l then out[#out + 1] = table.concat({ "L", kind, key, tostring(l.limit or 500), tabfree(l.cat) }, "\t") for _, r in ipairs(l.rows) do out[#out + 1] = table.concat({ "R", kind, key, tostring(r.place or 0), tabfree(r.who), tabfree(r.value), tabfree(r.date) }, "\t") end end end end end local path = meta_file() local f = io.open(path .. ".tmp", "wb") if not f then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Could not write @x048" .. path .. ".tmp") return end f:write(table.concat(out, "\n"), "\n") f:close() os.remove(path) -- Windows rename will not replace an existing file os.rename(path .. ".tmp", path) end
local function meta_load() local f = io.open(meta_file(), "rb") if not f then return end for line in f:lines() do line = line:gsub("\r$", "") local t = {} for field in (line .. "\t"):gmatch("([^\t]*)\t") do t[#t + 1] = field end local kind, key = t[2], t[3] if t[1] == "K" and META_KINDS[kind] then mcache[kind] = { stamp = (t[3] ~= "" and t[3] or nil), at = tonumber(t[4]) or 0, lists = {} } elseif t[1] == "L" and mcache[kind] and STATS[key] then mcache[kind].lists[key] = { limit = tonumber(t[4]) or 500, cat = t[5] or "", rows = {} } elseif t[1] == "R" and mcache[kind] and mcache[kind].lists[key] then local rows = mcache[kind].lists[key].rows rows[#rows + 1] = { place = tonumber(t[4]), who = t[5] or "", value = t[6] or "", date = t[7] or "" } end end f:close() end
-- a finished metarank scan -> mcache. Returns how many lists came back. local function meta_store(s) local kind = s.kindkey or "day" local e = mcache[kind] or { lists = {} } local got = 0 for _, c in ipairs(s.done) do if c.key and c.cat then e.lists[c.key] = { cat = c.cat, limit = c.limit, rows = c.rows or {} } got = got + 1 end end if got == 0 then return 0 end -- a scheduled read counts as done for this slot even if a category never answered; -- a partial LIVE lookup does not, so the next tick still reads the full set if s.refresh or got >= #META_ORDER then e.stamp = meta_due(kind) end e.at = os.time() mcache[kind] = e meta_save() return got end
local function meta_has(kind) local e = mcache[kind] return e and next(e.lists) ~= nil end
local function when(t) if not t or t == 0 then return "never" end return (os.date("%b %d %I:%M%p", t):gsub(" 0", " ")) end
local function report_meta(s) if #s.done == 0 then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W No " .. s.kind.word .. " metarank lists came back.") return end local byk, who, found = {}, s.target, 0 for _, c in ipairs(s.done) do if c.key and not byk[c.key] then byk[c.key] = c end if c.best then who = c.best.who; found = found + 1 end end
if s.chan then -- sent even when every stat is N/A, so whoever asked gets an answer local parts = {} for _, k in ipairs(META_ORDER) do local c, st = byk[k], STATS[k] if c and c.best then parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@x045%s @x099%s @x048%s @w%s", st.short, ordinal(c.best.place), c.best.value, c.best.date) else parts[#parts + 1] = "@x045" .. st.short .. " @wN/A" end end Execute(s.chan .. " @x045" .. who .. "@W " .. s.kind.word .. " bests: " .. table.concat(parts, " @x099|@W ") .. "@w") return end
cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045] @x099" .. who .. "@W - " .. s.kind.word .. " bests, from metarank" .. (s.from and (" @D(lists read " .. when(s.from) .. ")") or "") .. "@W:") for _, k in ipairs(META_ORDER) do local c, st = byk[k], STATS[k] if c and c.best then cnote(string.format(" @x045%-13s @x048%9s @W%s @x099%s @Dall time", st.label, c.best.value, c.best.date, ordinal(c.best.place))) elseif c then cnote(string.format(" @x045%-13s @w%9s @D(not in the top %d)", st.label, "N/A", c.limit or 500)) else cnote(string.format(" @x045%-13s @w%9s @D(no reply from the game)", st.label, "N/A")) end end -- a title nothing matched means the category numbers need a look for _, c in ipairs(s.done) do if c.key and not stat_ok(STATS[c.key], c.cat) then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Heads up: metarank @x048" .. STATS[c.key].num .. "@W came back as @x045" .. c.cat .. "@W, not " .. STATS[c.key].label .. ".") end end end
-- ranked value of a stored row local function row_total(cur, row) if not cur.colidx then return "?" end local ncols = #cur.cols if ncols == 0 then ncols = 1 end return row.nums[#row.nums - ncols + cur.colidx] or "?" end
local function report(s) local p = s.p if #s.hits == 0 then cnote("@x045[@x099" .. p.label .. " Ranks@x045] @x099" .. s.target .. "@W is not in the top " .. TOP_N .. " of any scanned category.") return end
if s.chan then local parts = {} for _, h in ipairs(s.hits) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@x045%s @x099#%d@W: @W%s @x048%s", shorten(h.cat), h.rank, h.who or s.target, h.total or "?") end Execute(s.chan .. " @x099" .. p.label .. "@W - " .. table.concat(parts, "@W, ") .. "@w") else cnote("@x045[@x099" .. p.label .. " Ranks@x045] @x099" .. s.target .. "@W - top " .. TOP_N .. " appearances: @x048" .. #s.hits) for _, h in ipairs(s.hits) do cnote(" @x045" .. shorten(h.cat) .. "@W: @W" .. (h.who or s.target) .. " @x099#" .. h.rank .. " @W- @x048" .. (h.total or "?")) end end end
-- one category, with the people around the player local function report_rt(s) local p = s.p local c = s.done[1] if not c then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W No " .. p.label:lower() .. " ranking came back for category @x048" .. s.catnum) return end if not c.rank then cnote("@x045[@x099" .. p.label .. "@x045] @x045" .. c.cat .. "@W: @x099" .. s.target .. "@W was not found in the list.") return end
-- 5 rows: 2 above, the player, 2 below; with nobody above, the window extends below local first = math.max(1, c.rank - 2)
if s.chan then local parts = {} for r = first, first + 4 do local row = c.rows[r] if row then local nm = (r == c.rank) and "@x045" or "@W" local tag = clan_tag(row.clan, "") parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@x099#%d %s%s%s @x048%s", r, (tag ~= "" and (tag .. " ") or ""), nm, row.who, row_total(c, row)) end end Execute(s.chan .. " @x099" .. p.label .. " @x045" .. shorten(c.cat) .. "@W - " .. table.concat(parts, "@W, ") .. "@w") else cnote("@x045[@x099" .. p.label .. "@x045] @x045" .. c.cat) for r = first, first + 4 do local row = c.rows[r] if row then local nm = (r == c.rank) and "@x045" or "@W" cnote(string.format(" @x099#%-4d %s %s%-14s @x048%s", r, clan_tag(row.clan, " "), nm, row.who, row_total(c, row))) end end end end
-- top 10 of one category local function report_top(s) local p = s.p local c = s.done[1] if not c then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W No " .. p.label:lower() .. " ranking came back for category @x048" .. s.catnum) return end
if s.chan then local parts = {} for r = 1, 10 do local row = c.rows[r] if row then local tag = clan_tag(row.clan, "") parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@x099#%d %s@W%s @x048%s", r, (tag ~= "" and (tag .. " ") or ""), row.who, row_total(c, row)) end end Execute(s.chan .. " @x099" .. p.label .. " @x045Top 10 " .. shorten(c.cat) .. "@W - " .. table.concat(parts, "@W, ") .. "@w") else cnote("@x045[@x099" .. p.label .. "@x045] @x045" .. c.cat .. "@W - top 10") for r = 1, 10 do local row = c.rows[r] if row then cnote(string.format(" @x099#%-3d %s @W%-14s @x048%s", r, clan_tag(row.clan, " "), row.who, row_total(c, row))) end end end end
-- one stat, all four periods ("pupreport") local function report_multi(s) local st = s.stat if #s.done == 0 then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W No " .. st.label:lower() .. " rankings came back (category @x048" .. st.num .. "@W).") return end local byp = {} for _, c in ipairs(s.done) do byp[c.period] = c end local title = shorten(s.done[1].cat) local who = s.target for _, c in ipairs(s.done) do if c.who then who = c.who; break end end
if s.chan and #s.hits > 0 then local parts = {} for _, p in ipairs(PORDER) do local c = byp[p.key] if c and c.rank then parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@W%s @x099#%d @x048%s", p.label, c.rank, c.total or "?") else parts[#parts + 1] = "@W" .. p.label .. " @w-" end end Execute(s.chan .. " @x045" .. title .. "@W for @x045" .. who .. "@W - " .. table.concat(parts, "@W, ") .. "@w") return end
cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045] @x045" .. title .. "@W for @x099" .. who) for _, p in ipairs(PORDER) do local c = byp[p.key] if c and c.rank then cnote(string.format(" @W%-8s @x099#%-4d @x048%s", p.label, c.rank, c.total or "?")) elseif c then cnote(string.format(" @W%-8s @wnot in the top %d", p.label, TOP_N)) else cnote(string.format(" @W%-8s @Dno reply", p.label)) end end if s.chan then cnote(" @D(not in the top " .. TOP_N .. " anywhere, so nothing was sent to " .. s.chan .. ")") end end
finish = function() EnableTriggerGroup("scan", false) EnableTriggerGroup("meta", false) local s = scan if s.cur then table.insert(s.done, s.cur); s.cur = nil end s.hits = {} for _, c in ipairs(s.done) do if c.rank then s.hits[#s.hits + 1] = c end end scan, lastscan = nil, s if s.meta then local got = meta_store(s) if s.refresh then if got == 0 then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W No " .. s.kind.word .. " metarank lists came back; trying again in " .. (REFRESH_RETRY / 60) .. " minutes.") else cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Saved the " .. s.kind.word .. " metarank lists (@x048" .. got .. "@W of " .. #META_ORDER .. ").") end -- you were AFK and the commands took you out of it: put it back once if s.was_afk then DoAfterSpecial(3, "OnMetaAfkCheck()", 12) end DoAfterSpecial(5, "OnMetaTick()", 12) -- the next kind that is due, if any else report_meta(s) end elseif s.multi then report_multi(s) elseif s.rt then report_rt(s) elseif s.top then report_top(s) else report(s) end -- friendly stat commands: flag a category number that is not the stat it claims to be if s.stat and s.done[1] and not stat_ok(s.stat, s.done[1].cat) then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Heads up: category @x048" .. s.stat.num .. "@W came back as @x045" .. s.done[1].cat .. "@W, not " .. s.stat.label .. ". The number in the STATS table needs fixing.") end end
-- "" or "-" means no channel (echo locally) local function norm_chan(chan) if chan == nil or chan == "" or chan == "-" then return nil end return chan end
local function norm_target(t) if t == nil or t == "" then return myname() end return t end
local function start_scan(key, chan, target) if scan then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W A scan is already running, hang on.") return end scan = { p = PERIODS[key:lower()], chan = norm_chan(chan), target = norm_target(target), gen = 0, done = {}, hits = {} } EnableTriggerGroup("scan", true) cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Scanning " .. scan.p.label:lower() .. " rankings for @x099" .. scan.target .. "@W (lists gagged)...") -- send everything at once; replies are split by their headers for _, n in ipairs(CATS) do Send(scan.p.cmd .. " " .. n) -- Send, not Execute: avoids re-entering our own aliases end scan.gen = scan.gen + 1 DoAfterSpecial(6, "OnRankStart(" .. scan.gen .. ")", 12) end
local function start_rt(key, catnum, chan, target, stat) if scan then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W A scan is already running, hang on.") return end scan = { p = PERIODS[RT[key:lower()]], rt = true, catnum = catnum, stat = stat, chan = norm_chan(chan), target = norm_target(target), gen = 0, done = {}, hits = {} } EnableTriggerGroup("scan", true) Send(scan.p.cmd .. " " .. catnum) scan.gen = scan.gen + 1 DoAfterSpecial(6, "OnRankStart(" .. scan.gen .. ")", 12) end
local function start_top(key, catnum, chan, stat) if scan then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W A scan is already running, hang on.") return end -- key is tyrt/tmrt/tdrt/twrt -> drop the leading "t" to get yrt/mrt/drt/wrt scan = { p = PERIODS[RT[key:lower():sub(2)]], top = true, catnum = catnum, stat = stat, chan = norm_chan(chan), target = "", gen = 0, done = {}, hits = {} } EnableTriggerGroup("scan", true) Send(scan.p.cmd .. " " .. catnum) scan.gen = scan.gen + 1 DoAfterSpecial(6, "OnRankStart(" .. scan.gen .. ")", 12) end
-- metarank for every stat at once; replies are told apart by their "ranking type" title. -- kind = "day" / "year" / "week" (meta_kind) -- answer from the saved lists: no game commands at all local function meta_lookup(kindkey, chan, target) local e = mcache[kindkey] local s = { meta = true, kind = META_KINDS[kindkey], kindkey = kindkey, from = e.at, chan = norm_chan(chan), target = norm_target(target), done = {} } local tl = s.target:lower() for _, key in ipairs(META_ORDER) do local l = e.lists[key] if l then local c = { key = key, cat = l.cat, limit = l.limit } for _, r in ipairs(l.rows) do if r.who:lower() == tl then c.best = r; break end end s.done[#s.done + 1] = c end end report_meta(s) end
-- scheduled read of one kind's eight lists into the cache (no report) local function start_refresh(kindkey) local k = META_KINDS[kindkey] scan = { p = { label = "Metarank" }, meta = true, refresh = true, kind = k, kindkey = kindkey, quiet = META_QUIET, target = "", was_afk = (gState == 4), gen = 0, done = {}, hits = {} } EnableTriggerGroup("meta", true) for _, st in ipairs(META_ORDER) do SendNoEcho("metarank " .. STATS[st].num .. k.flag) end scan.gen = scan.gen + 1 DoAfterSpecial(8, "OnRankStart(" .. scan.gen .. ")", 12) end
-- GMCP states it is safe to send commands in: active, AFK, sleeping, resting local SAFE_STATE = { [3] = true, [4] = true, [9] = true, [11] = true }
-- why a refresh would wait right now, or nil local function refresh_blocked() if not IsConnected() then return "not connected" end if scan then return "another lookup is running" end if not gState then return "waiting for GMCP" end if not SAFE_STATE[gState] then return "busy (fighting, in a note, the pager or running)" end if gPK then return "in a PK room" end return nil end
-- 60s timer (and chained after each refresh): read the next kind that is due function OnMetaTick() if refresh_blocked() then return end local now = os.time() for _, kind in ipairs(KIND_ORDER) do local e = mcache[kind] if not (e and e.stamp == meta_due(kind, now)) and now - (gRefreshTry[kind] or 0) >= REFRESH_RETRY then gRefreshTry[kind] = now start_refresh(kind) return end end end
function OnMetaAfkCheck() if gState == 3 and IsConnected() then SendNoEcho("afk") end end
local function start_meta(chan, target, kind) local kk = meta_kind(kind) if meta_has(kk) then meta_lookup(kk, chan, target) return "cached" end if scan then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W A scan is already running, hang on.") return end local k = META_KINDS[kk] scan = { p = { label = "Metarank" }, meta = true, kind = k, kindkey = kk, quiet = META_QUIET, chan = norm_chan(chan), target = norm_target(target), gen = 0, done = {}, hits = {} } EnableTriggerGroup("meta", true) cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Reading " .. k.word .. " metarank for @x099" .. scan.target .. "@W (lists gagged)...") for _, st in ipairs(META_ORDER) do Send("metarank " .. STATS[st].num .. k.flag) end scan.gen = scan.gen + 1 DoAfterSpecial(8, "OnRankStart(" .. scan.gen .. ")", 12) return "ok" end
-- one stat in all four periods; replies are told apart by the period in their header local function start_multi(stat, chan, target) if scan then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W A scan is already running, hang on.") return end scan = { p = { label = stat.label }, multi = true, stat = stat, catnum = stat.num, chan = norm_chan(chan), target = norm_target(target), gen = 0, done = {}, hits = {} } EnableTriggerGroup("scan", true) for _, p in ipairs(PORDER) do Send(p.cmd .. " " .. stat.num) end scan.gen = scan.gen + 1 DoAfterSpecial(6, "OnRankStart(" .. scan.gen .. ")", 12) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------- -- aliases ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function alias_echo(name, line, w) start_scan(w[1], nil, nil) end
function alias_channel(name, line, w) start_scan(w[1], w[2], w[3]) end
function alias_rt(name, line, w) start_rt(w[1], tonumber(w[2]), w[3], w[4]) end
function alias_top(name, line, w) start_top(w[1], tonumber(w[2]), w[3]) end
-- metarank / metayear / metaweek [channel [name]] function alias_meta(name, line, w) start_meta(w[2], w[3], w[1]) end
-- For MadBot ("madbot meta"): CallPlugin(id, "RankTracker_Meta", "<chan>|<name>[|year|week]"). -- One string argument on purpose; <chan> may be two words ("tell Bob"), which the -- metarank alias cannot take. Returns "ok", or "busy" when a scan is already running. function RankTracker_Meta(arg) local chan, rest = tostring(arg or ""):match("^([^|]*)|(.*)$") if not chan or chan == "" or not rest or rest == "" then return "bad" end local who, kind = rest:match("^([^|]*)|(.*)$") if not who then who = rest end if who == "" then return "bad" end if not meta_has(meta_kind(kind)) and scan then return "busy" end return start_meta(chan, who, kind) -- "cached" (answered at once) or "ok" (live scan started) end
-- For MadBot: "yes" when meta / metayear / metaweek would answer from the saved lists -- (nothing sent to the game, so no lag guards needed). kind = "" / "year" / "week". function RankTracker_MetaCached(kind) return meta_has(meta_kind(kind)) and "yes" or "no" end
-- metastatus function alias_metastatus(name, line, w) cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Saved metarank lists @D(" .. meta_file() .. ")@W:") local now = os.time() for _, kind in ipairs(KIND_ORDER) do local e, k = mcache[kind], META_KINDS[kind] local n = 0 if e then for _ in pairs(e.lists) do n = n + 1 end end local state = (e and e.stamp == meta_due(kind, now)) and "@x048up to date" or "@x099due, read at the next chance" cnote(string.format(" @x045%-7s @Wread @x048%s@W, @x048%d@W of %d lists, %s", k.label, when(e and e.at), n, #META_ORDER, state)) end cnote(" @DDaily at 12:01am, weekly Sunday 12:01am, yearly Jan 1 12:01am.") local why = refresh_blocked() if why and why ~= "another lookup is running" then cnote(" @DRight now a read would wait: " .. why .. ".") end end
-- metarefresh [day|week|year] (none = all three) function alias_metarefresh(name, line, w) local a = (w[1] or ""):lower() local kinds = (a == "" or a == "all") and KIND_ORDER or { meta_kind(a) } for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do if mcache[kind] then mcache[kind].stamp = nil end gRefreshTry[kind] = nil end local why = refresh_blocked() if why then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Will read the lists as soon as possible (" .. why .. ").") else cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Reading the metarank lists again (gagged)...") end OnMetaTick() end
-- <name> metarank / metayear / metaweek [channel] function alias_meta_name(name, line, w) local who = w[1]:sub(1, 1):upper() .. w[1]:sub(2):lower() start_meta(w[3], who, w[2]) end
-- pupreport [top] [d|w|m|y] [channel [name]] function alias_stat(name, line, w) local key = w[1]:lower() local st = STATS[key] local cmd = key .. "report" local t = {} for tok in (w[2] or ""):gmatch("%S+") do t[#t + 1] = tok end
local i, top, rtkey = 1, false, nil if t[i] and t[i]:lower() == "top" then top = true; i = i + 1 end if t[i] and PERIOD_WORDS[t[i]:lower()] then rtkey = PERIOD_WORDS[t[i]:lower()]; i = i + 1 end
local chan, target = t[i], t[i + 1] local extra = t[i + 2] if top then -- top 10 takes a two-word channel ("tell Bob") and no name if target then chan = chan .. " " .. target; target = nil end end if extra or (chan and not (chan == "-" or chan:match("^[A-Za-z]"))) then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Usage: @x048" .. cmd .. " @W[@x048top@W] [@x048d@W|@x048w@W|@x048m@W|@x048y@W] [channel [name]] @D(rankhelp for examples)") return end
if top then start_top("t" .. (rtkey or "drt"), st.num, chan, st) elseif rtkey then start_rt(rtkey, st.num, chan, target, st) else start_multi(st, chan, target) end end
function alias_name(name, line, w) local n = w[1] if n == nil or n == "" then SetVariable("charname", "") cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Default name is now the logged-in character: @x099" .. myname()) else SetVariable("charname", n) cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Default name set to @x099" .. n) end end
function alias_debug(name, line, w) if not lastscan then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W No scan has run yet.") return end for _, c in ipairs(lastscan.done) do local cols = c.cols or {} -- metarank lists have no column table local colname = cols[c.colidx or 0] or "?" cnote(" @x045" .. (c.cat or "?") .. "@W columns: @x099" .. table.concat(cols, ", ") .. "@W total from: @x048" .. colname .. "@W rank: @x099" .. (c.rank and ("#" .. c.rank) or "-")) end end
